payload.reason: The evidence provides specific improvement margins for the Zero-Shot Adaptive Transfer (ZAT) method compared to other models, indicating a clear quantifiable improvement in performance metrics.

claims.text: ZAT outperforms state-of-the-art systems by a margin of 7.24% in absolute F1-score with 2000 training instances.
ZAT shows an improvement of 14.67% in absolute F1-score over CRF when training with 500 instances.
ZAT achieves a statistically significant mean improvement of 4.04 points over LSTM-BoE with training size 500.
ZAT achieves an F1-score of 76.04% with only 500 training instances, outperforming the CRF model which scores 75% with 2000 instances.
